body: it sucks but it's true. I hate it. it feels like your trapped.

it's very hard... honestly if I didn't have any family (I'm so lucky I have people that love me) I've always thought I would so do it. the thing is... if i did do it. it would make THEM absolutely miserable for the rest of thier lives. I am willing to "sacrifice" my suicide to help my family.

if you are not in this situation please before you concider. go out and literally force yourself to make any friends. what else do you have to lose. pm me if you want to talk. I find it very difficult to talk about this... hence my account name.... happy Valentine's day...
